scripts.android:prepare: npm run build && cap sync android && node scripts/prepare-android-assets.mjs
scripts.android:release: npm run android:prepare && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleCustomerRelease assembleAdminRelease assembleStockRelease && cd .. && node scripts/collect-android-artifacts.mjs
scripts.android:release:update: npm run android:release && node scripts/publish-android-update.mjs && npm run build
scripts.release:site-and-android: npm run android:next-update && npm run verify:android-update && npx vercel deploy --prod --yes
scripts.android:bundle: npm run android:prepare && cd android && gradlew.bat bundleCustomerRelease bundleAdminRelease bundleStockRelease
